name: Merge PDF
description: Combine multiple PDFs into one ordered document.

name: Split PDF
description: Save every page as a separate PDF in a ZIP.

name: Compress PDF
description: Reduce file size using Ghostscript; result may vary.

name: Rotate PDF
description: Rotate all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

name: Extract pages
description: Extract selected pages, e.g. 1,3-5.

name: Delete pages
description: Remove selected pages without modifying the original file.

name: Page numbers
description: Stamp clear page numbers on each page.

name: Watermark PDF
description: Apply your text watermark across the document.

name: Protect PDF
description: Encrypt a PDF using your chosen password.

name: Unlock PDF
description: Decrypt a PDF with its correct owner-provided password.

name: Crop PDF
description: Trim margins from all pages, measured in points.

name: Grayscale PDF
description: Convert pages to grayscale, producing a flattened PDF.
notice: This process rasterizes pages; text selection may be lost.

name: PDF to TXT
description: Extract embedded text from a PDF.

name: TXT to PDF
description: Create a readable PDF from a plain text file.

name: PDF to JPG
description: Render each page as a JPG in a ZIP.

name: PDF to PNG
description: Render each page as a PNG in a ZIP.

name: JPG to PDF
description: Combine JPG images into one PDF.

name: PNG to PDF
description: Combine PNG images into one PDF.

name: PDF to Word
description: Extract PDF text into an editable DOCX.
notice: Text is editable, but complex layout may not be preserved.

name: PDF to Excel
description: Extract detected tables into a real XLSX workbook.
notice: Requires detectable tables; arbitrary PDF layouts are not spreadsheets.

name: PDF to PowerPoint
description: Convert each PDF page into an image-based PowerPoint slide.
notice: Slides contain page images, not independently editable objects.

name: Repair PDF
description: Attempt to rebuild a damaged but readable PDF.

name: Flatten PDF
description: Render PDF pages into a non-editable PDF.
notice: This rasterizes page content and may increase file size.

name: Edit PDF metadata
description: Set title and author properties in a PDF.

name: Remove blank pages
description: Remove pages without detectable text or graphics.

name: Add blank page
description: Append a blank page matching the last page size.

name: Compare PDFs
description: Create a plain text difference report between two PDFs.

name: Extract PDF images
description: Extract embedded raster images into a ZIP.

name: OCR PDF
description: Make scanned PDF pages searchable using Tesseract OCR.

name: Fill PDF form
description: Fill an existing PDF form field by its exact name.

name: Word to PDF
description: Convert Word documents into PDF using LibreOffice.

name: Word to TXT
description: Extract the text content of a Word document.

name: TXT to Word
description: Convert a plain text file into an editable DOCX.

name: Word to HTML
description: Convert text and basic paragraphs to HTML.
notice: Complex tables and layout may not be preserved.

name: HTML to Word
description: Convert HTML text into an editable Word document.
notice: This conversion preserves text, not complex styling.

name: Merge Word files
description: Combine document paragraphs in order.
notice: Advanced headers, styles and embedded objects may not be preserved.

name: Excel to PDF
description: Export spreadsheet pages to PDF using LibreOffice.

name: CSV to Excel
description: Convert CSV data into a real spreadsheet.

name: Excel to CSV
description: Export each worksheet into a separate CSV within a ZIP.

name: Excel to HTML
description: Export worksheet tables to an HTML file.

name: Slides to PDF
description: Convert slides into a PDF using LibreOffice.

name: Slides to PNG
description: Render slides as PNG images inside a ZIP.

name: Slides to TXT
description: Extract slide text into a TXT file.

name: Images to slides
description: Create one slide per uploaded image.

name: JPG to PNG
description: Convert a JPG image to PNG.

name: PNG to JPG
description: Convert PNG to JPG with a white transparent background.

name: WEBP to JPG
description: Convert a WEBP image to JPG.

name: JPG to WEBP
description: Convert JPG images to WEBP.

name: PNG to WEBP
description: Convert PNG images to WEBP.

name: Resize image
description: Resize while preserving image proportions.

name: Rotate image
description: Rotate images using your chosen angle.

name: Compress image
description: Re-encode an image as optimized JPG.

name: Remove image metadata
description: Save a fresh image without EXIF metadata.

name: Images to PDF
description: Combine mixed supported images into one PDF.
